<ChangeLog Value="v0.4.0 上传打通与界面修订 / v0.4.0 upload path and UI pass. - 新增：选中市辖区后，区面板底部出现「上传蓝图」：填名称、选社区类型、写简介，就在本机草稿箱生成一张蓝图（道路、地形、建筑、设施、功能区各成一节，内容寻址）。 New: with a district selected, the district panel gains an Upload blueprint button - name, community type and description, and a blueprint draft is written to the local outbox (roads, terrain, buildings, props and zoning each as their own content-addressed section). - 改动：面板右上角改为账号按钮，未登录显示「登录」，登录后显示头像；左边一句提示说明上传入口在区面板。 Changed: the top-right is now the account button (Sign in when logged out, avatar when logged in) with a hint that uploads start from the district panel. - 改动：面积一律按 u 讲（1u = 8m x 8m，一个功能区单元格），三档重划为小 <1000u、中 1000~4000u、大 >4000u。 Changed: areas are stated in cells (1u = one 8m x 8m zoning cell) with the three bands redrawn: small <1000u, medium 1000-4000u, large >4000u. - 改动：排序扩到 8 项：最热门、最近更新、最晚创建、最早创建、面积最大、面积最小、名称 A到Z、名称 Z到A。 Changed: eight sort orders. - 改动：社区类型改成 8 项（全部 + 住宅区、商业区、产业区、公园区、文教区、交通枢纽区、公共服务区），取消混合区；选中类型的定义说明显示在左栏清单下方。 Changed: eight community types (All plus seven), mixed dropped, and the definition of the selected type now sits under the list. - 改动：面积与排序两个下拉互斥，点外面即收起；面板透明度默认 90%。 Changed: the two dropdowns are mutually exclusive and close on outside click; default panel transparency is 90%. - 稳定性：临时文件自动清理（载入时清临时目录、关闭面板时再清、封面缓存限量、草稿箱只留最近 12 张）。 Stability: temporary files are pruned automatically (on load, on panel close, cached covers are capped, the draft outbox keeps the latest 12).
v0.3.1 界面修订 / v0.3.1 UI fixes. - 修复：左上角入口方块显示成一块白色方块，现在是蓝底 + 白色区划图案。 Fixed: the top-left entry tile showed as a plain white square; it is now the blue tile with a white district-plan glyph. - 修复：类别选中底色、卡片描边、当前页码高亮有时整块不显示。 Fixed: category highlight, card borders and the current page marker could be missing entirely. - 改动：入口方块与相邻模组图标自动排成一排，不再互相压住。 Changed: entry tiles line up in one automatic row with other mods instead of overlapping. - 改动：没有封面的蓝图改用内置绘制图案。 Changed: blueprints without a cover image get a drawn placeholder.
v0.3.0 UI and copy pass after in-game testing. - Fixed: the panel transparency slider had no effect at all (its range was declared in the wrong scale, so the value never changed). It is now 0-100% and takes effect live; default raised to 80%. - Changed: the top-left entry is now a blue square tile with a white district-plan glyph, matching the other mod tiles in that row. - Changed: the upload affordance in the panel header is an icon button instead of a sentence. - Changed: blueprint cards are larger with tighter spacing, so the list fills the panel. - Changed: all player-facing text was rewritten to match the game's own terminology and now goes through the game localization, so Bridge the Language Gap can translate the panel. - Removed: the built-in sample blueprints. The panel now shows only real workshop content.
v0.3.0 实机后的界面与文案修订。 - 修复：面板透明度滑条完全没生效（量程声明用错了刻度，数值永远被夹住）。现在 0~100% 实时生效，默认提到 80%。 - 改动：左上角入口改成蓝底白色区划图案的方块，与那一排其它模组图标同一规范。 - 改动：面板右上角的上传入口由一句话改成图标按钮。 - 改动：蓝图卡片加大、间距收紧，列表不再显得空。 - 改动：所有玩家可见文案按游戏官方用词重写，并改走游戏本地化，可被 Bridge the Language Gap 翻译。 - 移除：内置示例蓝图。面板只显示工坊里的真实内容。" />
